claims.claim: Toronto police announced 82 criminal charges against seven accused on Oct. 14, 2026, in a probe that began with a July 25 abduction.
Police allege the victim, a cryptocurrency exchange owner, was abducted at gunpoint near Finch Avenue East and Bayview Avenue, handcuffed and assaulted.
Police allege suspects tried to gain access to the victim's cryptocurrency assets and business security systems.
The victim was released, threatened and warned not to contact police; he had minor injuries and has recovered, police say.
Talarambage Fernando, 22, James Moreau, 29, and Jack Miley, 24, are reservists in the 7th Toronto Regiment, per DND.
Fernando and Moreau were arrested Aug. 11 and Miley on Sept. 24.
DND says the three were removed from duties and had access restricted, remaining CAF members pending an administrative review.
Police allege about 2,500 rounds of ammunition and five over-capacity magazines were stolen from the CAF and had not been reported stolen beforehand.
Seizures included a shotgun, two 3D-printed handguns, two silencers, over 2,700 rounds of ammunition and illicit drugs.
No connection between the accused and a larger organized crime group has been established.
The victim's identity has not been made public.

Miley, 24, faces seven charges including kidnapping for ransom with a firearm and forcible confinement; Fernando, 22, faces 20 counts.

Miley is a master bombardier who deployed on Operation Reassurance in 2025; Fernando enrolled January 2020 and has not deployed on a CAF operation; Moreau enrolled March 2018 and deployed on Operation Laser in 2020.
DND says the three were removed from duties and had access restricted, remaining CAF members pending an administrative review.
The investigation remains ongoing per the Toronto police news release.

Police allege the victim owned a cryptocurrency exchange and was targeted for it.
Police allege he was abducted at gunpoint on July 25 near Finch Avenue East and Bayview Avenue in North York, handcuffed and assaulted.
Police say the victim was later released, threatened and warned not to contact police; he had minor injuries and has recovered.
The victim's identity has not been made public.
Chief Myron Demkiw announced 82 charges on Wednesday, Oct. 14, 2026.

claims.claim: Talarambage Fernando, 22, James Moreau, 29, and Jack Miley, 24, are reservists in the 7th Toronto Regiment.
